#####
# SUMMARY
***

This report was developed in rmakdown to compare results of different cases of Humboldt Squid Stock simulations. It collects the output files of “Run HSquid_Rmd.R” script. The parameters by cases are shown in tables and the main variables (recruitments, biomass, fishing selectivity, catches, etc.) are shown in graphs.

# INTRODUCTION
***

The ‘SQUIDSIM.rmd’ rmardwon script was developed to simulate Humboldt Squid Stock dynamics using an input parameter file named HSquid_Par.csv.

The ‘SQUIDSIM_RunCases_Purl.R’ R script was written to conduct different simulation by means of run ‘SQUIDSIM.rmd’ with different input parameters and to save parameters and main results in csv format file and graphs in png format files. 

Therefore, it was neccesary to write a rmarkdown script to report on the different simulations outputs (‘SQUIDSIM_RunCases_Purl.R’).

# METHODS
***

No calculations were done in this script. The figures and tables are read from the current folder. 

The individual, population and fishery parameters are shown in tables 1 to 3.


#####
# RESULTS
***
## Table 1. Individual Parameters by case.
```{r echo=FALSE}
library(knitr)
ind.pars.cases.tab=read.table("ind.pars_Cases.csv",header=TRUE,sep=",")
colnames(ind.pars.cases.tab)[1]<-"Case"
knitr::kable(ind.pars.cases.tab)
```
<br>
